description: Build nextjs-lms-saas starter - Courses, memberships, and video with Clerk, Neon/Prisma, Mux, Stripe, and UploadThing
steps: Create nextjs-lms-saas/ directory with .gitignore

Create package.json with exact-pinned deps: next@15.3.4, react@19.0.0, react-dom@19.0.0, @clerk/nextjs, @prisma/client, stripe, @mux/mux-node, uploadthing, @uploadthing/react. DevDeps: typescript@5.8.3, vitest@3.2.1, fast-check@3.23.2, eslint@9.28.0, eslint-config-next@15.3.4, tailwindcss@4.1.10, @tailwindcss/postcss@4.1.10, postcss@8.5.4, prisma, @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom

Create starter.json matching catalog entry (id:5, technologies:[TypeScript, Clerk, Neon, Prisma, Mux, Stripe, UploadThing], auth:Clerk, data:Neon + Prisma, monetization:Stripe memberships, integrations:[Mux, UploadThing])

Create prisma/schema.prisma with models: Course (id, creatorId, title, description, published, createdAt, updatedAt), Lesson (id, courseId, title, description, position, videoAssetId, videoPlaybackId, videoStatus enum, createdAt, updatedAt), Enrollment (id, userId, courseId, status enum [active,expired,cancelled], createdAt, updatedAt), Progress (id, enrollmentId, lessonId, completed, completedAt, createdAt), Subscription (id, userId, stripeCustomerId, stripeSubscriptionId, stripePriceId, status enum [active,past_due,cancelled,trialing], currentPeriodEnd, cancelAtPeriodEnd, createdAt, updatedAt), ProcessedEvent (id, providerEventId unique, eventType, processedAt). Include initial migration.
Create domain/entities.ts with types for Course, Lesson (with VideoStatus), Enrollment (with EnrollmentStatus), Progress, Subscription (with SubscriptionStatus), ProcessedEvent

Create domain/policies.ts with: AuthContext (userId, role:creator|learner), canCreateCourse (creator only), canEditCourse (course creator only), canEnroll (any authenticated learner), canAccessLesson (enrolled + active subscription), canViewProgress (enrollment owner). Deny-by-default.

Create lib/server/config.ts with ConfigSpec for: CLERK_SECRET_KEY, CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, DATABASE_URL, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, MUX_TOKEN_ID, MUX_TOKEN_SECRET, MUX_WEBHOOK_SECRET, UPLOADTHING_TOKEN, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
Create lib/server/errors.ts with AppError, BillingError, WebhookVerificationError, UploadError, sanitizeProviderError
Create lib/server/auth.ts with Clerk adapter (getAuthContext from request)
Create lib/server/billing.ts with BillingPort (createCheckout, verifyWebhook, handleWebhookEvent) and StripeAdapter with HMAC webhook verification for subscription lifecycle
Create lib/server/billing-fake.ts with FakeBillingAdapter
Create lib/server/video.ts with VideoPort (createAsset, getAssetStatus, getPlaybackUrl) and MuxAdapter
Create lib/server/video-fake.ts with FakeVideoAdapter tracking asset creation and status
Create lib/server/upload.ts with UploadPort (validateUpload, getUploadUrl) and UploadThingAdapter with MIME/size enforcement
Create lib/server/upload-fake.ts with FakeUploadAdapter
Create lib/server/database.ts with Prisma client singleton
Create lib/server/providers.ts for adapter instantiation
Create middleware.ts protecting /dashboard with Clerk auth check
Create app/page.tsx - public course catalog landing page
Create app/dashboard/page.tsx - protected dashboard (creator: manage courses, learner: enrolled courses + progress)
Create app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts - Stripe webhook with raw body verification
Create app/api/webhooks/mux/route.ts - Mux webhook for video processing status updates
Create next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, vitest.config.ts
Create .env.example with all placeholder values
Create tests/unit/domain/policies.test.ts
Create tests/unit/server/billing.test.ts
Create tests/unit/server/video.test.ts testing Mux adapter fake
Create tests/unit/server/upload.test.ts testing upload validation
Create tests/integration/enrollment.test.ts testing enrollment + payment unlock flow
Create tests/integration/auth.test.ts
Create tests/property/auth-consistency.test.ts (Property 4)
Create tests/property/webhook-authenticity.test.ts (Property 5) covering Stripe webhook
Create tests/smoke/build.test.ts
Create README.md
Run pnpm install, lint, typecheck, test, build
acceptance_criteria: nextjs-lms-saas/ directory exists with all required files
pnpm install succeeds with committed lockfile
pnpm lint, typecheck, test, build all pass
Property 4 and Property 5 tests present and passing
Video (Mux) and upload (UploadThing) adapters have fakes
Enrollment flow: payment unlocks lesson access
